- Use the Write tool to create the files (read each source fully first with the Read tool). Reply with only a one-line confirmation listing the files written.

handback.t:
DONE. Private repo https://github.com/socrates6969/ap-recovery (visibility PRIVATE, branch master, 5 commits, all authored as Marius Carlsson <[REDACTED:email]>, each ending with "Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <[REDACTED:email]>"). Local path: C:\Users\mariu\ventures\ap-recovery. No ruflo/ruvnet content.

WHAT WAS BUILT (freight pattern, package ap_recovery, env APR_, key apk_):
- Platform foundation (copied/adapted from freight): API-key auth + tenant isolation, SQLAlchemy/Alembic Postgres persistence, sandboxed worker parsing, storage stub, hash-locked requirements, Dockerfile, compose, CI (6 jobs), Dependabot, deploy/aws.md + Terraform skeleton. Skipped later freight add-ons: webapp, developer-portal site, forecast module, marketing site.
- Domain src/ap_recovery/{ingest,extraction,rules,evidence,api}: ingests AP payment register, invoice register (CSV or pipe-table text) and vendor statements (CSV, TXT, text-layer PDF); strict Decimal parsing (rejects 1.234,56, NaN, 1e999, etc.; row-numbered warnings, never silent zeros); no FX.
- Rules: DUP-EXACT, DUP-VARIANT (INV-3002 vs INV-0003002), DUP-FUZZY (Damerau, transposition=1), DUP-NEAR-AMOUNT, OVERPAY, WRONG-VENDOR, CUR-MISMATCH (unquantified), CREDIT-UNAPPLIED, CREDIT-ON-STATEMENT, STMT-OPEN-NOT-IN-AP (exposure, kept separate from recoveries), STMT-PAID-NOT-APPLIED / STMT-AMOUNT-MISMATCH (info). Shared claim ledgers ensure a claim never exceeds the real overpayment; installments summing to the invoice are not flagged; repeated export rows are not duplicates; only register-backed exact dups/overpayments count as confirmed, everything fuzzy goes to pending review.
- Evidence: packet JSON + markdown with source-row citations, SHA-256 of each input file plus json/markdown integrity digests (verify_packet), per-vendor DRAFT claim list (vendor-facing text only requests confirmed items; unverified items in an internal block with sender checklist). Everything marked DRAFT.
- API: /v1/analyze, /v1/analyze/text, list/get, /packet.md; base_currency and batch_label params.

TESTS: 2,021 passed / 1 skipped locally (Windows, Py3.14); 2,019 passed / 3 skipped with every request through a real sandbox worker subprocess. 1,756 of these are the seeded duplicate-detection invariant/edge-case suite (300 seeds vs an independent oracle; order independence, name-spelling independence, cap never exceeds overpayment, etc.); mutation spot-checks (remove claim cap / installment guard / variant-review / payment-id dedupe) each made the suite fail. GitHub Actions run 37283059662 on master: all six jobs green (SQLite in-process + process sandbox, PostgreSQL 16, pip-audit, trivy repo + image, container smoke test). Fixtures are synthetic (tests/fixtures/q3); no accuracy figure exists and README says so.

DOCS (English, plus Norwegian .no.md translations of 13 of them via sub-agents, spot-checked only at the header level): README, ARCHITECTURE, business/{business-plan,market-analysis}, financial/model, technical/overview, fundraising, hiring, marketing/{seo-and-growth,landing/*}, legal/DPA-DRAFT.md (GDPR Art. 28 template, explicitly DRAFT / not counsel-reviewed / with honest TOM status), deploy EU-residency section. NOTICE/AUTHORS/README banner/pyproject = Marius Carlsson (c)2026 socrates6969. Market analysis states plainly: CROWDED (PRGX, Apex Analytix, ERP-native duplicate checks, AP suites like Basware/Coupa), weak moat, skeptic downgraded to DEFER, built anyway per owner; wedge = mid-market self-serve free scan; bounded experiment with kill criteria. Financial model: every input labelled ASSUMPTION (base case ~$1.44M run-rate Y5, bootstrappable; $1B shown only as what-would-have-to-be-true); no fabricated metrics, no market-size figure, no named investors.

CAVEATS: competitor characterizations are general knowledge and unverified (no live research; the docs say so). Norwegian translations were not human-reviewed; English is authoritative. Dependabot opened its own PRs on the new repo (normal, e.g. sqlalchemy 2.1.2 bump; not merged). The ap-recovery repo was not scanned by anything beyond CI trivy (secrets: clean).
